import * as fs from 'node:fs/promises';
const c = JSON.parse(await fs.readFile(Bun.argv[2], 'utf8')); const verdict = Bun.argv[3], report = Bun.argv[4]; if (!['SUCCESS', 'FAILURE'].includes(verdict) || !report?.trim()) throw Error('Supply actual verdict and complete assigned-axis report');
const timestamp = new Date().toISOString(); const body = '## Verdict

' + verdict + '

## Scope

Ticket ' + c.ticketRef + '; branch ' + c.branch + '; base master at ' + c.base + '; frozen source ' + c.commit + '; tree ' + c.tree + '. Timestamp ' + timestamp + '.

' + c.files.map(p => '- ' + p).join('
') + '

## Standards

' + (c.role === 'standards' ? report : 'Not assessed by this independent Spec role; separate Standards and main reviews remain required.') + '

## Spec

' + (c.role === 'spec' ? report : 'Not assessed by this independent Standards role; separate Spec and main reviews remain required.') + '

## Findings

The assigned-axis report above records its findings. Structured result metadata records each blocking finding separately.

## Validation

Previously recorded full Bun suite152pass0fail2145assertions13files and scopedcompiler0: ' + c.checksRef + '. Actual exact-source native matrix35passed24cases and owned cleanup0: ' + c.nativeRef + '. Final-source public-modal/event consumer smoke8pass0fail171assertions: ' + c.consumerRef + '. Real SGR mouse ancestor activation passed: ' + c.mouseRef + '. These are recorded observations, not tests personally executed by this reviewer.

## Limits

This role assesses its complete assigned axis, not the other independent axis or final acceptance. SVGfallback does not establish exact glyph/colour pixel fidelity. No integration/push/canonical completion claim.

## Next step

' + (verdict === 'SUCCESS' ? 'Complete remaining independent reviews before finish.' : 'Fix blocking findings in a fresh authorized session, then obtain a new exact-source review.') + '
';
const fields = { title: 'Ticket06 independent ' + c.role + ' review', reviewed_commit: c.commit, reviewed_tree: c.tree, review_role: c.role, verdict, timestamp }; const p = Bun.spawn(['mise', 'exec', '--', 'mq', '--allow-http-import', '--no-lockfile', '-I', 'null', '-F', 'text', '--args', 'body', body, '--no-clobber', '--output', c.artifact, 'import "github.com/harehare/okf.mq" | okf::okf_new("Report",' + JSON.stringify(fields) + ',body) | okf::okf_stringify(.)'], { cwd: c.root, stdout: 'pipe', stderr: 'pipe' }); const [stdout, stderr, code] = await Promise.all([new Response(p.stdout).text(), new Response(p.stderr).text(), p.exited]); if (code) throw Error(stderr); console.log(JSON.stringify({ artifact: c.artifact, verdict, source_commit: c.commit }));
